data.title: 吹雪 · 书房的人事档案
data.description: 她的书房，墙上挂着城市地图，桌上摊着各队人事评估表；台灯下她逐页批注，偶尔在某个名字旁画星——女王的王国是这样一块块垒起来的。
data.action: 她的书房，墙上挂着城市地图，桌上摊着各队人事评估表
data.promptProse: Fubuki annotates the team personnel assessments in her study, pausing to draw a star beside a promising name. A dark-green cardigan covers her cream blouse above tailored black trousers, pearl earrings catching the focused light. The medium portrait includes the spread forms and city map on the wall behind. Her desk lamp illuminates the pen hand and page surfaces, with layered paper shadows at the table edge and a darker map border beyond.
